title: Storytelling
idea: Brief #28. Shot-for-shot swipe of Wild Dose's "Two weeks ago I looked six months pregnant" (227 days live; reliable UK bloating brand with ~30 ads live, several 190-256 days). VO story over B-roll, script line for line, only the product (castor oil + cotton belly wrap) and offer swapped, plus a proof beat (thousands of women, 43,000+ customers). Our own VO + B-roll winners back the format: #181, #2 ($6.7k), #108/#106 ($12.2k). Bloating = Johnny's next big angle.

editing_notes:
Replicate the reference shot for shot (227 days live). 100% B-roll: no talking to camera; the VO tells the story and every line gets its own clip that ACTS OUT that exact line (timestamps in each row = the reference's matching shot). ~60 s, new clip every 2-4 s, small white sentence-case captions centre screen word by word, no extra graphics.
HOW TO BUILD EACH SHOT: (1) Genjitsu ONLY where realism needs it (full-body movement): the hook (0:00 belly hold + flat-stomach cut) and rows 4, 5, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14. Cut the reference clip at that row's timestamp and load it into Genjitsu as the MOTION reference. Everything else (hands, food, tea, phone screens, product, close-ups: rows 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9, 15, 16, 17) = Library B-roll first, then normal AI generation, real product photos for the product. (2) Same woman in every Genjitsu shot (make her once, reuse); copy the reference's movement, camera angle, framing and timing almost 1:1. (3) Real phone look: handheld, natural light, real skin texture, nothing glossy. (4) [Bracketed] words in Visual = what the shot must show; use them in your prompt. (5) Product only at the pickup (0:30) and the end, our real bottle + wrap, correct size, label to camera. (6) No before/after side-by-sides. (7) Claims: feel and look only; no gut, detox or digestion claims. (8) First frame = the bloated belly hold, exactly like the reference.
OFFER: confirm the Complete Castor Oil Kit (oil + wrap) deal + landing page with the client before launch. Doc: Brief H+S, tab #28.

Voiceover: One woman, 30s to 40s, telling her story to a friend: relaxed, honest, a little fed up at the start and genuinely relieved at the end. Copy the reference's pacing and tone exactly. NEEDS TO HAVE CONVICTION in their voice, it's boring to listen to a dull script. They need to speak with character.

Avatar: Real-looking woman 30 to 40, fit and normal like the reference creator, shot on a phone, natural light, casual clothes (sundress, gym set, sweats). Same woman across all clips. Use Genjitsu (reference clip as the motion reference) only on the movement shots listed in the editing notes. Product = our real Haven & Spool castor oil bottle + cotton belly wrap (Products tab photos as the reference).
